AddOnInstructionDefinition.Description: This AOI is used to both log operators in and out from a machine, and to verify the credentials that the user has for the given machine.

Initial Release.

AddOnInstructionDefinition.AdditionalHelpText:
This AOI is used to provide the associated access level based on the user's badge Id.
The AOI takes into account the training classes that the user has successfully completed, and returns up to five different integer values to the PLC indicating the access level(s) that the user is qualified for. The highest integer value is always in the 1st array element of the AOI output, and up to five different levels can be returned at once.
The integer value associated with the user's level is set by the training web site administrator(s). Higher values do not always mean greater access; they could simply mean "different" access. Therefore, care must be taken when receiving thesed values to insure that the correct system accessibility is set based on the user's credentials.
If the user is attempting to logon while another user is logging on, then the first user will be automatically logged off in the database records, and replaced by the new user as the user currently accessing the machine. All login/logout access events are recorded in the Db for record keeping purposes.
If the user's badge Id is not found in the system, or if any other error is encountered, then all of the five possible access levels will be set to zero.
